start.speaker: Nadia · People team
start.text: Thanks for coming in, Raka. Please, sit down.

news.speaker: Nadia
news.text: The restructuring includes your team. Your role is being removed. This isn't a performance decision.

choices.text: Can you email me the details?

project.speaker: Nadia
project.text: Another team will take it over. You've left it in good shape. I know that doesn't make this easier.

details.speaker: Nadia
details.text: Of course. The notice period, severance, and reference letter. You don't have to remember all of this now.

close.speaker: Raka
close.text: Okay. I'll hand over my notes.

choices.text: Not yet. It's been a strange day.
I'll get something in a minute.

honest.speaker: Raka
honest.text: The company let my team go. There are other jobs. I just... haven't opened the messages yet.

quiet.speaker: Mom
quiet.text: You sound tired. Is work keeping you late again?

admit.speaker: Raka
admit.text: Not anymore. They cut the team today.

mom.speaker: Mom
mom.text: Oh, Raka. Have something to eat first.

home.speaker: Mom
home.text: You can just come home if you're tired.

bike.speaker: Raka
bike.text: Is Dad still keeping the gate key in the same place?

key.speaker: Mom
key.text: Yes. And he still thinks I don't know.

start.speaker: Sari
start.text: Move your bag in a bit. The water comes off that corner.

choices.text: Please. Less sugar, if that's okay.
Yes, thank you. I'll wait here a while.

sugar.speaker: Sari
sugar.text: You and my husband. He says that, then steals my drink.

wait.speaker: Sari
wait.text: Take that chair. The other one's got a short leg.

rider.speaker: Delivery rider
rider.text: That a Thunder outside? My uncle had one. Yours looks better.

father.speaker: Raka
father.text: Dad helped me keep it that way.

far.speaker: Delivery rider
far.text: That's a few more cups of tea from here.

room.speaker: Sari
room.text: There's a guesthouse down the road. Green sign, just after the fields. They'll have a dry place for your bike.

yes.speaker: Raka
yes.text: Please. And could I check the front tire?

air.speaker: Attendant
air.text: Air hose is beside the pump. No hurry.

night.speaker: Raka
night.text: Yes. Somewhere I can park the bike under a roof?

roof.speaker: Guesthouse owner
roof.text: Right beside the kitchen. Tea in the morning, if you're up.
